name: Views Default Argument: Node Title from URL
description: A Views default argument giving the node title from the URL's node ID.
project_description:
This tiny module provides a "Node title from URL" Views Default Argument , so that you can for example create views that show content with the exact same title. The module also ships with a (disabled) example with this that functionality.

 This solves https://www.drupal.org/forum/support/post-installation/2010-10-25/using… programmatically.
